# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the classic f-sac game (Standard)
# 1. e3 e6 2. Qf3 Qf6 3. Qxf6 gxf6 4. f4 Nc6 5. c3 Bc5 6. d4 Bb6 7. Bf1>>x(0T1)f7+ Kxf7 8. Nh3 Nf6
# 9. Ng5+ Ke8 10. c3 d5 11. Qb3* Bb6>>(0T4)b3 12. (-1T5)Bd3* Ke8>>(0T4)d8 13. Nb1>>x(-1T5)b3#.
# Move 12 forces mate in 2 (the engine also finds another mate in 2 there). Move 13 is left out:
# in that position dozens of actions mate at once.
